title: Candidate assistant
intro: Explore professional evidence from candidates referred to one of your company's jobs.
review: Answers support analysis and must be reviewed by the team responsible for the recruitment process.
noJobs: Your company has no jobs yet.
jobsLimit: The first 50 jobs are shown. Jobs outside this limit are not available in this MVP.
noCandidates: No candidates have been referred to this job yet.
partialSources: Some resumes are missing or have no extractable text. Analysis uses available professional sources without automatic OCR.
sending: Retrieving evidence and preparing an answer…
question: Your question
inputHelp: Enter sends. Shift + Enter adds a new line.

suggestions.technical: Compare adherence to the job's technical requirements
suggestions.experience: Which candidates have documented experience related to this job?
suggestions.leadership: Show documented evidence of professional leadership
suggestions.missing: Which mandatory requirements lack supporting evidence?
suggestions.differences: Summarize the main documented differences between candidates

limitations.human_review: Review the sources before using this analysis. The assistant does not decide hiring or rejection.
limitations.insufficient_evidence: I did not find enough evidence in the retrieved materials. This does not mean the skill is absent.
limitations.partial_sources: Some sources are incomplete. Only selected excerpts were analyzed; documents may contain additional information.
limitations.no_candidates: No candidates are available for this job.
limitations.professional_only: Compare professional criteria only. The assistant does not use personal or protected attributes or execute hiring decisions.
limitations.initiative_only: A resume cannot establish personality. This comparison only considers documented evidence of professional initiative.

errors.entrada_invalida: Check your question and its size limits.
errors.sessao_expirada: Sign in again to use the assistant.
errors.acesso_negado: You do not have access to this job or these candidates.
errors.vaga_inexistente: This job is no longer available.
errors.muitos_candidatos: This job exceeds the MVP limit of 24 candidates. Analysis was stopped to avoid an incomplete comparison.
errors.curriculo_nao_autorizado: A resume's ownership could not be verified. Review its registration before continuing.
errors.indice_desatualizado: Documents changed or the index expired. Refresh documents before asking again.
errors.limite_uso: Usage limit reached. Wait before trying again.
errors.limite_provider: The AI service reached its quota. Try again later.
errors.provider_nao_configurado: The AI assistant is not configured in this environment yet.
errors.privacidade_provider: Sending data to the AI service has not been enabled for this environment yet.
errors.provider_timeout: The AI service took too long to respond. Try again later.
errors.resposta_invalida: The answer failed source validation. Rephrase your question or try again.
